name: Kontor Space Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Kontor Space Ltd provides co-working services by leasing and managing commercial spaces[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KSL is the first co-working space company to be listed on the Indian stock market. It is in the business of acquiring and leasing properties, which it subleases to a single or multiple clients on a per-seat basis, providing flexible and modern workspace solutions. It also invests in refurbished properties to meet their client requirements which mainly comprise startups, SMEs, and independent professionals

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
